# URAWAKE Stackhouse
> Web development studio by Daniel Sangronis. Builds full-stack web apps, CRMs, and API integrations for small businesses.

## Contact
- Email: daniel.sangronis1386@gmail.com
- Website: https://urawake-website.vercel.app/

## Services
- Full-stack development (React, Node.js, Django, PostgreSQL)
- API integration (Stripe, Gmail API, REST, Webhooks)
- CRM and business tools (leads, bookings, campaigns, automation)
- UI/UX build (Figma to code, responsive, motion-enhanced)
- Deployment (Vercel, Heroku, Netlify, CI/CD)

## Projects
- Eliot's Adventures: Full website for a Puerto Rico tour and taxi service with tour listings, travel guides, and online booking. Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe, Gmail API, Heroku.
- ToursToDo PR: Marketing website for ToursToDo Puerto Rico with tour catalog, island guide content, and Stripe-powered booking flow. Stack: React, Vite, React Router, CSS Modules, Stripe, Vercel.
- ToursToDo CRM: Internal operations platform with lead management, bookings, email campaigns, affiliate tracking, and AI-powered lead qualification. Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe, SendGrid, Heroku.

## Stack
JavaScript, React, Python, Django, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, REST APIs, Stripe, HTML, CSS, Git, Vercel, Heroku
